messages:
alicia: Heads-up — SAST CI started failing after the RBAC change to the keystore service. Scanners can't decrypt artifacts, seeing 403s from KMS. Anyone oncall who can confirm?
marco: I'm seeing the same in staging, reproduces locally with the new role binding. quick log: `kms:Decrypt returned status 403`
secbot: [alert] CI-job #6421 failed: sast-scan (link: https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/6421) :rotating_light:
samira: tagging @owen — do we have a temporary mitigation? We can't unblock the release with SAST failing.
owen: Reverting the RBAC change now would be safest. Alternatively we can grant the scanner the ephemeral 'keystore-decrypt' role until we patch. Which service account is in the scan pipeline?
alicia: The pipeline uses `svc-scan-runner@redwood` (GH action service account). The PR that landed was #3124, binding `role/keystore-reader` -> `infra-team` (rolled out 30m ago).
marco: quick workaround: add `iam.bind` for `svc-scan-runner` with a conditional ttl 1h. Example IAM command we used earlier:
```
 gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding svc-scan-runner@redwood \
   --member=serviceAccount:svc-scan-runner@redwood \
   --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
samira: That'll work but need audit trail. Also make sure KMS logs are ingested to AuditLog (splunk). We should capture the exact failing attempts for postmortem.
owen: I'm OK doing the ephemeral grant. Will add an audithook note in the PR and ping infra to revoke after.
alicia: Also noticed DAST pipeline started flapping on staging health checks — could be unrelated but coincident. Opening an incident tracker: https://incident.redwood.example/INC-2026-0923
secbot: [incident] INC-2026-0923 created by alicia — tag: sdlc-scan-failure. Pager duty notified.
marco: For triage steps: 1) add ephemeral role to svc-scan-runner, 2) re-run SAST job, 3) collect KMS audit logs (`protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"`), 4) if still failing, rollback PR #3124.
samira: Also need to update runbook section "SAST KMS decrypt failures" — it currently assumes `svc-scanner` had static perms. I'll draft a short addendum and push to docs repo.
owen: Doing ephemeral grant now, will post command and audit binding id here once done.
alicia: Thanks — small ask: can someone follow up with seccomms for customers on Dedicated who might be affected? We should be proactive if prod pipelines hit same. :eyes:
marco: I'll take seccomms. Adding note to ticket.
secbot: [automation] Re-run requested for CI-job #6421 by owen.
alicia: Update: ephemeral grant applied, re-run started. If green we'll revert infra binding change and schedule a safer rollout later with an explicit scanner role mapping.
samira: Nice. After this we should add a preflight check to the RBAC rollout job that runs a mock decrypt using the `svc-scan-runner` identity. That would have caught this one.
owen: Agree — I'll add a quick smoke test step to the RBAC deploy workflow.
marco: Postmortem owner? alicia or samira?
alicia: I can own the postmortem, samira will co-author the runbook update.
marco: Cool. Closing loop: if re-run passes, we'll revoke the ephemeral grant and revert PR #3124 rollout.
alicia: Yep — will update ticket with revoke timestamp. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
